products.name: Google Workspace Admin SDK & API Automation / Reporting Toolkit — Commercial
products.short_description: Build a Google Workspace Admin SDK & API automation/reporting toolkit — secure least-scope auth, Python against Directory/Reports/Drive/Groups, reusable automation + reporting patterns, and scheduling — so administration and evidence are automated and auditable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Automate and report on Google Workspace with the Admin SDK and APIs

Manual admin work and screenshot ‘reports’ don’t scale in a large Workspace tenant. This solution builds an Admin SDK & API automation/reporting toolkit: a secure service identity (OAuth / domain-wide delegation done right), authenticated Python against the Directory, Reports, Drive, and Groups APIs, reusable automation and reporting patterns (provisioning, license, sharing, and audit reports), and a scheduling model — so administration and evidence are automated, repeatable, and auditable.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the automation model: auth (OAuth / domain-wide delegation, least-scope), the key APIs (Directory/Reports/Drive/Groups), reusable patterns, and scheduling.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace super-admin, a project + service identity, least-privilege scopes, Python toolchain).
  • Implementation Guide — set up the service identity + least-scope auth, build authenticated API access, implement automation + reporting patterns, and schedule them — pilot-first; no keys in code (use a secured credential/ADC).
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (auth least-scope, reports accurate, automation idempotent) plus Best Practices for secure, maintainable Workspace automation.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Workspace administration and reporting automated, repeatable, and auditable — secure least-scope API access, reusable provisioning/license/sharing/audit reports, scheduled — no more manual screenshots.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • gwsdk_auth_scope_validator.py — validate the automation service identity & least-scope OAuth setup
    • gwsdk_provision_users.py — idempotent user/OU/license provisioning automation (dry-run by default)
    • gwsdk_schedule_config_helper.py — scheduling & config helper for the toolkit (read-only, generates config)
    • gwsdk_sharing_audit_report.py — Drive external-sharing & login/admin audit report (read-only)
    • gwsdk_tenant_discovery.py — read-only Workspace discovery / assessment report (Directory API)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
